```{r setup}
library(IMPACTfunctions)
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
```

# Open Dataset in R session:

```{r}

# Load real data
IMPACTfunctions::load_dataset(folder_path = "~/data/dwhitake/data/IMPACT/20260129",
             prefix = "SCB_Periop_",
             suffix ="_20260129.parquet",
             verbose = TRUE)

#If you do not have a real dataset, load the synthetic dataset
load_synthetic_dataset()

```


# Filter dataset to get study cohort

## Use whole dataset as study cohort

```{r}

rm(eligibility_criteria)

dataset <- cohort_complete_admissions(procedures_table = Procedures, verbose=TRUE)

#Use the glimpse function to peer into the dataset
dataset %>% glimpse()
```


```{r}
#Use single `cohort_enforce` statements
dataset <- Procedures %>% cohort_enforce_opt_out(verbose=TRUE) 

#Or chain together multiple enforce statements
dataset <- Procedures %>% cohort_enforce_discharged(verbose=TRUE) %>%
  cohort_enforce_procedure_coded(verbose=TRUE)

#Use the help to see the family of cohort_enforce functions
?cohort_enforce_family

```


```{r}



#Use the collect function to pull the dataset into memory as a dataframe
dataset_df <- dataset %>% collect()
```


Examine the eligibility criteria used in the filtering
```{r}
#See the eligibility criteria that has been applied
print(eligibility_criteria)

```
